component.name: Godot Hub
component.summary: Godot Engine version and project manager

description.p: **This is an independently maintained fork of MakovWait/godots with a significantly redesigned UI and additional features.**
Godot Hub is a desktop app for managing your Godot Engine versions and projects in one place.
Download different versions of Godot, keep multiple versions side-by-side, and organize your projects with a modern and clean interface.
Key improvements over the original Godots:

ul.li: Automatic in-app update notifications and installer
Smart platform filtering — only shows builds for your OS
Built-in Godot news feed with thumbnail previews
